name: feishu-docs
description: Feishu document skill pack with vendored document, wiki, drive, sheet, media, comment, and auth scripts from hashSTACS-Global/feishu-skills.
description_cn: 飞书文档能力包，内置来自 hashSTACS-Global/feishu-skills 的文档、知识库、云空间、表格、媒体、评论与授权脚本。

presentation.summary: 读取、搜索和编辑飞书文档、知识库与云空间内容。
presentation.access_note: 会访问你授权的飞书空间；创建、覆盖或评论内容前仍需明确确认。

script_entries.name: update_doc

workflow: Use this skill for Feishu document, wiki, drive, sheet, media, and comment requests only.
Run the auth script first when a user token is missing.
Use the relevant sub-skill SKILL.md files for exact arguments before calling a script entry.
